import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.array([0, 1, 2])

pmf = np.array([
    0.25,
    0.50,
    0.25
])

cdf = np.cumsum(pmf)

print("PMF:", pmf)
print("CDF:", cdf)

plt.figure(figsize=(7, 4))

plt.bar(
    x,
    pmf,
    width=0.5
)

plt.xticks(x)
plt.xlabel("Number of Heads")
plt.ylabel("Probability")
plt.title("PMF")

plt.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(7, 4))

plt.step(
    x,
    cdf,
    where="post"
)

plt.xlim(-0.5, 2.5)
plt.ylim(0, 1.1)

plt.xticks(x)
plt.xlabel("Number of Heads")
plt.ylabel("Cumulative Probability")
plt.title("CDF")

plt.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
